text.I tried to forget with a beer, but 7-Ele: Nilijaribu kusahau kwa kunywa bia, lakini 7-Eleven nchini Malaysia huuza pombe hadi saa tatu usiku tu
text.I visited a student dorm right next to S: Nilitembelea bweni la wanafunzi lililo karibu kabisa na Sunway University
text.On day 2 of the university visits, I wen: Siku ya pili ya kutembelea vyuo vikuu, nilikwenda Asia Pacific University (APU).
text.The one who showed us around the school: Kijana wa miaka 19 ndiye aliyetutembeza chuoni.
text.He was so mature that I could not believ: Alikuwa mkomavu kiasi kwamba sikuamini kuwa alikuwa na miaka 19 tu.
APU ilikuwa na vifaa vya NVIDIA.
Pia alituambia kuhusu seva iliyokuwa ndani.
Inaonekana ina chipu za NVIDIA ndani yake.
text.I forgot the unit, but was it 100 billio: Nimesahau kipimo, lakini zilikuwa tokeni bilioni 100?
text.Anyway, I think he explained that it can: Nadhani alieleza kuwa inaweza kuendesha kwa wingi huduma kama ChatGPT na Claude.
text.Besides NVIDIA, there was a place to lea: Mbali na NVIDIA, kulikuwa na nafasi ya kujifunza Cisco, na bila shaka AWS na Google Cloud.
text.Anyway, this APU is really strong in tec: Kwa vyovyote vile, APU ina uwezo mkubwa sana katika teknolojia.
text.It felt like you could do anything relat: Nilihisi kwamba mambo yoyote yanayohusiana na teknolojia yanawezekana hapo.
text.I felt the future a lot, and I thought i: Nilihisi sana uwepo wa siku zijazo na nikafikiri ni chuo kikuu kizuri kweli.
text.It is a university that I really wanted: Nilitamani sana kusoma katika chuo kikuu hiki.
text.I went for my sister's university visit,: Nilikwenda kwa ziara ya chuo kikuu ya dada yangu mdogo, lakini APU ilinivutia sana na kila kitu kilikuwa kizuri.
text.I thought it was a very attractive unive: Niliona ni chuo kikuu kinachovutia sana kwa watu wanaotaka kuingia kwenye teknolojia.
Pia walituonyesha chumba cha bweni la APU.
text.They showed us the dorm room, and the AP: Walituonyesha chumba cha bweni, na vyumba vya bweni vya APU vilikuwa safi sana.
text.And it is on the campus, so the location: Bweni hilo liko ndani ya kampasi, kwa hiyo eneo lake ni zuri.
